title: 2023 SELECT FOOTBALL JI'AYIR BROWN CONCOURSE BLACK AND RED PRIZM DIE-CUT RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Select Football card features Ji'Ayir Brown from the San Francisco 49ers. The card is a Concourse Black and Red Prizm Die-Cut RC, with a card number of 91. It is an original, English language trading card manufactured by Panini in the United States. 

The card is a single product from the 2023 Select Football set, and is a rookie card. It is a parallel/variety card, with features that make it stand out. The card is not autographed and is not a vintage or licensed reprint. It is a great addition to any football fan's collection.
